action.objective: Capture the c7 queen with Nxc7+, forcing Bxc7, then follow with Qa3 or Qb5+ to exploit the exposed black king and undeveloped pieces.
action.rationale: Nxc7+ is the only commit_ready move: verified depth 4, exact score +19, safety.complete with no immediate mate and tactical_refutation not_found. It wins the queen for the knight, a clear material gain (queen for knight), even though Black recaptures with Bxc7. The broad depth-3 search also ranked Nxc7+ top at +43. PV continues Qb5+ hitting the e8 king and f6g4 knight. No risk acceptance needed; it is the verified best move.
